text:
tia: Heads-up: running a short enablement sync with CloudPartnerX next week. They want a simplified deployment guide and Terraform samples. Can we create a minimal `partner-ready` folder under the quickstart repo?
sam: yes. `partner-ready/` should contain a curated example with minimal variables and a `deploy.sh` that wraps `terraform` for partners who prefer scripts.
jorge: add a `validation/` script that checks for required provider versions and instance family availability in region. sometimes partners try deprecated instance types.
tia: good call. include a `notes.md` with region limitations and marketplace packaging tips. also include a `CHANGELOG.md` for partner-facing releases.
beta-bot: action-created: issue #12 in galaxy-quickstart-kit: add partner-ready folder and validation scripts. assignees: sam, jorge. due: 3 days.
sam: I'll start the PR tonight for the folder layout.
jorge: will write the validation script and a tiny Python check to call the AWS pricing API for cost estimates.
tia: let's keep the partner-ready examples opinionated: auth via OIDC or partner IAM role; avoid complex module outputs. partners want something they can run with minimal infra knowledge.
jorge: also adding a note to toggle benchmarking on/off. some partners don't want the bench to spin up infra.
tia: cool. we'll present this in the sync deck. thanks team.
